definitions.explanation: Reaching an agreement by each side giving up some demands. Finding a middle ground between opposing positions.

examples.japanese: {両者|りょうしゃ}は{妥協|だきょう}に{達|たっ}した。
{品質|ひんしつ}には{妥協|だきょう}しない。
{妥協点|だきょうてん}を{見|み}つけることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to find a point of compromise.

notes:
KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{妥|だ} - peaceful settlement
・{協|きょう} - cooperation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{妥協|だきょう}する - to compromise
・{妥協|だきょう}を{許|ゆる}さない - to allow no compromise
・{妥協点|だきょうてん} - point of compromise
・{妥協案|だきょうあん} - compromise proposal
・{妥協|だきょう}に{達|たっ}する - to reach a compromise
・{妥協|だきょう}の{余地|よち} - room for compromise

NEGATIVE USE:
{妥協|だきょう}しない is often used as a positive trait, meaning refusing to lower one's standards:
・{品質|ひんしつ}に{妥協|だきょう}しない - uncompromising on quality
・{味|あじ}に{妥協|だきょう}しない - no compromise on taste

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{譲歩|じょうほ} - concession, giving in
・{折|お}り{合|あ}い - settlement, understanding
・{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}り - meeting halfway

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in business, politics, and everyday discussion.
